column2: WARNING Transformer Radiator Bank Sign – Bank Can Drop When Unbolted – 8x12 Aluminum
column3:
Bank Can Drop When Unbolted. This WARNING Transformer Radiator Bank sign from CGAP Safety reads: RADIATOR BANK REMOVAL / BANK CAN DROP WHEN UNBOLTED / SUPPORT WITH RATED LIFT FIRST / KEEP CLEAR OF THE LIFT PATH. Written for Electric utility substations, power generation plants, transformer service shops.

Why this sign matters

Once the header bolts are loosened the bank hangs only from the rigging, and a shifting sling or missed bolt lets the bank swing or drop on anyone beneath or beside the lift path.

Where to post it

Mount on the transformer tank wall beside the radiator header flange, at eye level for the crew rigging the bank.

Who orders it

Substation maintenance supervisor, transformer field service crew lead, utility safety coordinator.

Rust-resistant .065 aluminum, UV-resistant print, pre-drilled in all four corners. Made in the USA. Related standards to review for your site: OSHA 1910.184; OSHA 1910.269; ANSI Z535.2. A sign supports your safety program; it does not replace guarding, lockout or training.
